description: This file is a shell script that analyzes coverage differences between two versions of a codebase. It leverages git diff, gcov coverage reports, and blame information to identify lines added or uncovered in the new version, and provides a report on commits that introduced uncovered code.
external_files: *.gcov'' (coverage report files for each source file)

methods.name: diff_lines
methods.description: Processes diff input to extract line numbers of added lines.
